meta.name: CCNL Vigilanza Privata e Servizi Fiduciari FEDERDAT — SF

family.reason: Private security, fiduciary services section (FEDERDAT, CNEL HV51).

sources.title: CCNL Vigilanza privata e servizi fiduciari FEDERDAT, 9 luglio 2026 (archivio CNEL HV51, accordo 245848)
CCNL Vigilanza privata e servizi fiduciari FEDERDAT, 4 maggio 2023 (archivio CNEL HV51, accordo 167336)

notes.text: CCNL FEDERDAT (CNEL HV51), servizi fiduciari. Conglobated pay, 13 months, hourly divisor 173, daily 26 on six days and 22 on five (Employment.full_time_week_days). The CCNL of 4 May 2023 pays one table (art. 139) until the renewal of 9 July 2026, in force 'da luglio 2026' (art. 4: read as 1 July), whose art. 156 gives the amounts in force and those of December 2026.

APPRENTICESHIP (Art. 32, 2026 text): pay, classification and hours of the apprentice follow the CCNL 'in applicazione del principio di parità di trattamento': modelled as 100% of the level; three years at most (art. 33).
LEVEL F: the 2023 table pays a level F (865.68 EUR, art. 139); the 2026 table has none. The file models the levels A-E.

limitation.remediation: Add the level F of the 2023 table until the renewal of July 2026.

notes.text: ORDINARY HOURS (Art. 143): the premiums of 40% on ordinary Sunday and holiday work by day and 50% on holiday work by night are modelled (supplement_bands SF_*); not modelled: the 50% of ordinary Sunday work by night of a worker whose rest day is another day, and the indennità sesto giorno of 10%.

limitation.remediation: Model the Sunday night premium and the sixth-day allowance of art. 143.

notes.text: HEALTH AND BILATERAL FUNDS: the ente bilaterale EBILAV and the health fund of the CCNL are not modelled; their amounts were not read on the text.

limitation.remediation: Read the fund articles of the 2026 text and model them as health_funds.

notes.text: SICKNESS COMPORTO (Art. 105): the job is kept for 240 days of several illnesses in a calendar year, 300 of one; the file keeps the 180 paid days.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

location.section: Art. 101 - Malattia; Art. 103 - Trattamento economico di malattia
location.quote: ha diritto alla normale retribuzione netta mensile per un periodo massimo di 180 giorni. [Art. 103] 100% (cento per cento) della retribuzione di fatto per i primi tre giorni (periodi di carenza); 75% (settantacinque per cento) della retribuzione di fatto dal 4° al 20° giorno; 100% (cento per cento) della retribuzione di fatto dal 21° giorno in poi.

provenance.transformation: The top-up reaches 100% for the three days of carenza, 75% for days 4-20, 100% from day 21, for 180 days (art. 86 of the 2023 text is the same).

reviews.scope: FEDERDAT CCNL of 4 May 2023 (CNEL 167336) and of 9 July 2026 (CNEL 245848), servizi fiduciari: artt. 139-141/156-158 pay, seniority, 13th (pp. 76-77, page images), 126/143 overtime (p. 72), 134/151 ferie (p. 74), 86/103 sickness (p. 51), 32 apprenticeship.
findings: New file: the servizi fiduciari of the FEDERDAT CCNL had no ruleset (the old federdat-sf file held the HV17 tables, now vigilanza-privata-assiv-sf).
